notToBeConfusedWith.name: Condensed milk
notToBeConfusedWith.note: Also concentrated by evaporation, but sweetened with added sugar; evaporated milk is unsweetened.

forms.label: Whole, canned
forms.sourceNote: Milk, canned, evaporated, with added vitamin A. Public domain. The record's own fluid-ounce portion gives 1.0651 g/ml, adopted as a true density because it is poured. USDA reports no sugars for this record, so sugarGPer100 is left off rather than estimated — the carbohydrate figure is almost entirely the concentrated lactose.
